steps.en: Install micromark, plus extension packages such as micromark-extension-gfm
steps.zh: 安装 micromark 及所需的扩展包

steps.en: Call it with the syntax and HTML halves of each extension
steps.zh: 调用它，传入每个扩展的语法半边和 HTML 半边

steps.en: Runs its state machine over every byte, emitting positioned tokens per the reference parsers
steps.zh: 用状态机走过每个字节，按参考解析器的行为产出带位置的 token

steps.en: Compiles the tokens to HTML, encoding or dropping raw HTML and dangerous protocols
steps.zh: 把 token 编译成 HTML，原始 HTML 和危险协议被编码或丢弃

value.en: HTML that matches cmark/cmark-gfm from a ~14 kB parser that is safe on untrusted input by default
value.zh: 从约 14 kB 的解析器里得到与 cmark/cmark-gfm 一致的 HTML，面对不可信输入默认安全

sources: readme.md main @ 2026-10-08 (gh api repos/micromark/micromark/readme): Install 'npm install micromark'; Use 'const result = micromark(value, { extensions: [gfm()], htmlExtensions: [gfmHtml()] })'; What is this: 'state machine that emits concrete tokens ... with positional info. It then compiles those tokens directly to HTML'; follows cmark/cmark-gfm
readme.md Security: 'micromark makes any markdown safe by default ... it encodes or drops them'; Feature highlights: 'smallest CM parser at ±14kb'
